scope: Diagnostics only; no UI automation, app/account actions, arbitrary invocation, or device file access.

transport.host: Apple Mobile Device Service via localhost:27015 on Windows
transport.frames: 4-byte big-endian JSON byte length followed by UTF-8 JSON; one request/response per USB connection

activation: Explicit Settings > ReVanced > USB diagnostics > Enable session; no socket or endpoint at launch.

authentication.code: 8 random UUID hexadecimal characters shown only in app UI
authentication.token: 32 random UUID hexadecimal characters returned only after pairing
authentication.stop_on: Background, manual disable, process termination or expiry
authentication.pc_storage: Windows current-user DPAPI protected token; no token in reports or stdout

operations.capture-stop: Stop native expensive capture and probe logging; retain evidence and normal requests/caches/decisions
operations.probe: Existing current-video branding service diagnostic only

lifecycle: Private socket queues; snapshot work only on main with generation/foreground check. Shutdown interrupts owned clients. Expired generation cannot operate a later session. A timed-out pending main job is cancelled and remains the sole queued job until main resumes.
reports: Compressed complete JSON transport envelope plus compact checkpoint summary saved outside IPA output. Exclusive filenames prevent replacement of older reports.
completion: Apple compilation and production packaging; wired discovery permitted, no regression/static-hook/GUI/archive tests or UI automation. End-to-end bridge requires installation of the new IPA and explicit session activation.
